observations.output: MERIDIAN FABRICATION CO. v. CASTELLAN LOGISTICS, INC. 2019 WL 4471203 (N.D. Ill. 2019). HOLDING: We hold that a limitation-of-liability clause in a commercial shipping contract between two sophisticated commercial parties is enforceable, even where the resulting loss exceeds the clause's stated cap, provided (1) the clause was conspicuously disclosed in the body of the contract and not buried in fine print, and (2) the plaintiff has not shown the clause was the product of unequal bargaining power. Because Meridian is a sophisticated freight shipper that negotiated the contract at arm's length, and the clause appeared in bold text in Section 7 of the agreement, both conditions are satisfied here. Castellan's motion for partial summary judgment on damages is GRANTED.
